title: Gokarna & Dandeli
kicker: The Western Ghats down to the Konkan coast
summary: Two night trains, a river camp in the forest, a waterfall, two temples and three beaches. Five days, and the first trip on this page.

days.title: Leaving Hyderabad
days.body: The 15:50 sleeper out of Nampally: 17050, the Hyderabad–Hubballi Express. Fourteen hours and about 660 km across the Deccan, through Wadi, Kalaburagi and Vijayapura, into Karnataka while we sleep.

days.title: Hubballi at dawn, then Dandeli
days.body: In at Hubballi by six, and straight on to Dandeli, on the Kali river in the forests of the Western Ghats. A whole day out on the water and in the trees, then a night in tents by the campfire.
days.meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner at the camp

days.title: A waterfall, then a temple at sunset
days.body: Up and out by 6 AM, down through the ghats to Vibhuti Falls. Then on to the sea for sunset at Murudeshwar, the temple on a headland with the giant Shiva looking out over the water.

days.title: Gokarna
days.body: Morning at the Mahabaleshwar Temple in Gokarna, then Om Beach and on to Kudle. Lunch by the sea, and back up the ghats to Hubballi for the 9 PM train home.

days.title: Back in Hyderabad
days.body: 17049 out of Hubballi at nine the night before, back across the Deccan overnight, and into Hyderabad Deccan by ten. Sand still in the bags, and a few hundred photos to go through.
